title: The Riemann hypothesis
summary: I ask whether every nontrivial zero of the zeta function has real part one half.

title: P versus NP
summary: I ask whether every problem whose answer is checked quickly can also be solved quickly.

title: Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness
summary: I ask whether smooth three-dimensional fluid data stays smooth for all time.

title: The Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
summary: I connect rational points on an elliptic curve to the behavior of its L-function at one.

title: The Hodge conjecture
summary: I ask which cohomology classes on a projective algebraic variety come from algebraic cycles.

title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
summary: I ask for a mathematically complete quantum Yang-Mills theory with a positive mass gap.

title: The Poincaré conjecture
summary: I record the three-sphere characterization as solved, with Perelman's proof and verification history.

title: The Collatz conjecture
summary: I send a positive integer through halving and 3n plus 1 and ask whether every path reaches one.

title: The Goldbach conjecture
summary: I ask whether every even integer greater than two is a sum of two primes.

title: The twin prime conjecture
summary: I ask whether infinitely many prime pairs differ by two.

title: The abc conjecture
summary: I relate coprime integers a, b, and c with a plus b equals c to the radical of abc.

title: The perfect cuboid
summary: I ask whether a rectangular box can have integer edges, face diagonals, and space diagonal.

title: The Hadwiger conjecture
summary: I connect graph coloring to complete graph minors and the chromatic number.

title: The Erdős-Straus conjecture
summary: I ask whether 4 divided by n is always a sum of three positive unit fractions for n greater than one.

title: Regularity of the 3x plus 1 map
summary: I ask for a structure theorem behind the computation that keeps returning to one.

title: Infinitely many perfect numbers
summary: I ask whether the list of numbers equal to the sum of the proper divisors of each never ends.

title: The existence of Einstein metrics
summary: I ask which smooth manifolds carry metrics whose Ricci curvature is a constant multiple of the metric.

title: The chromatic number of the plane
summary: I ask for the minimum colors needed so points one unit apart never share a color.
